title: Witch's House
start: Talk to Harvey, the crying boy west of Falador.

items.t: Leather gloves (Can be obtained during the quest)
Cheese (Can be obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: Combat gear (Magic equipment and water spells work best) and food for low level players

kills.t: Witch's experiment, a shapeshifting enemy with four forms that must be defeated back-to-back:

steps.t: Talk to Harvey standing by the long garden just west of Falador, just west of the crumbling wall which requires level 5 Agility to cross. [Chat: 1 What's the matter? › Accept]
Go to the front door of the house.
Look under the northern potted plant for the house key and enter.
Climb down the stairs into the basement.
If you didn't bring leather gloves, search the nearby crates for a pair. You may have to search several times.
While wearing leather gloves, enter the gate.
Open and search the cupboard, straight ahead on the western wall for a magnet.
Go back up the stairs and grab the cheese off of the table.
Go to the room located on the south end of the house.
Right-Click Use cheese on the mouse hole on the eastern wall. (If you accidentally eat it, it will respawn on the table.)
Use the magnet on the mouse.
Exit the door and make your way to the fountain, being careful not to be seen by the witch.

sub.t: Strategically walk behind the shrubs to hide, being sure to stand in the middle space of each shrub. Surge can be used; timing is key.

steps.t: Check fountain for a shed key.
Return east down the shrubs to the shed, being careful not to be caught by the witch, and open the door.
Try to take the ball, the experiment will appear and attack you.

sub.t: Don't forget to actually take the ball after the experiment has been killed.

steps.t: Kill the Witch's experiment four times.

sub.t: (All forms of the experiment/shapeshifter are weak to Water Spells).

p: The final form of the experiment.

steps.t: Return and talk to Harvey (getting caught teleports you outside, you'll keep the ball)
